name: Confetti Submit Button
description: Pill submit button that morphs into a loading dots state, then a success checkmark while a burst of confetti and sequins shoots out of it.
contents: Dark pill button with arrow icon and Submit label
Full-screen canvas for confetti and sequins
behavior: Click or Enter/Space keyup starts a loading state, then a success state
Confetti and sequins burst from below the button and fall with gravity and drag
Button resets to ready after a few seconds
Letters stagger in and out on each state change

needsCodeEdit.where: gravityConfetti and dragConfetti values in runtimeRef
w-[150px] h-10 classes on the button element

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the reset delay after success

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Adds window listeners for resize and keyup (Enter or Space triggers submit anywhere on the page) and removes them on unmount
Confetti canvas is fixed to the full viewport above the page
Confetti origin assumes the button is centered in the viewport
